item.title: Refactor orders status to OrderStatus
item.brief:
Refactor the registered `refactor-order-status` repository's `orders` crate.

Requirements:
- Add `src/status.rs` with public `OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }`, deriving at least Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash.
- Implement `OrderStatus::as_str(self) -> &'static str` returning lowercase names; Display prints the same.
- Implement FromStr<Err = ParseStatusError>; ParseStatusError is public, implements std::error::Error, and its message names the rejected input.
- Implement can_transition_to(self, next) for exactly pending->paid, pending->cancelled, paid->shipped, paid->cancelled.
- Change Order::status to OrderStatus, re-export OrderStatus and ParseStatusError from crate root, and use the enum everywhere so status string literals appear only in src/status.rs.
- Preserve observable behavior exactly, including errors, report output and ordering, and parsing.
- Run cargo test and address failures.
- Commit the work on the assigned branch; do not push or merge.
Acceptance: implementation meets all requirements, cargo test passes, commit exists.

evidence.none: Pure refactor with no visible or measurable output change; existing behavior is covered by the integration tests.

pr.body: Added src/status.rs with OrderStatus, ParseStatusError, FromStr, Display, and transition rules; re-exported both public types. Migrated order lifecycle operations, billing, shipping, and CSV/report handling to enum values. Report counts still sort by the same lowercase status names. Verification: cargo fmt --check passed; cargo test passed (2 unit tests, 3 integration tests); git diff --check passed; source scan confirmed lowercase status literals are contained in src/status.rs. Assumption: the explicitly required Order::status type change is accepted as the public API change.
pr.summary: Orders now use a typed OrderStatus with parsing, display, and lifecycle transition rules. Before: status was an unrestricted string; now: callers use the enum while CSV/report text and errors retain their existing behavior.
pr.title: refactor orders to use OrderStatus

risk.why: The required public Order::status type changes from String to OrderStatus, so downstream callers assigning arbitrary strings must adapt. The change is otherwise limited to order lifecycle and report handling; serialization and errors retain existing text. All five tests and formatting passed.
